name: getCloudService
description: Returns a service object for a cloud service such as Amazon S3, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Azure Blob or Azure Service Bus.

params.name: cloudCred
params.description: Credentials for the cloud vendor: either a struct, or the name of a credential alias defined in the ColdFusion Administrator or Application.cfc.

params.name: cloudConfig
params.description: Service configuration: either a struct (with a serviceName key such as S3, SQS, SNS, DYNAMODB, AZURE_BLOB or SERVICE_BUS), or the name of a config alias.

links.title: Get started with ColdFusion AWS Lambda
links.description: Using getCloudService to list and invoke AWS Lambda functions
